title: Atmospheric-neutrino processes at 248 keV: the CEvNS tail, loss of coherence, and exotic neutrino interactions
question: What atmospheric-neutrino CEvNS rate is expected at E_R >= 200 keV and in 225-271 keV in 2.84 t yr, what does loss of coherence at q = 246 MeV imply (form factor, incoherent quasi-elastic and excitation channels), and can any exotic neutrino interaction (magnetic moment, Z', scalar, dipole-portal HNL) produce a lone 248 keV NR?
headline_result: Normalised to LZ's 0.11 ROI events, coherent CEvNS gives 1-3e-5 events in 225-271 keV (4-12e-5 above 200 keV, Helm), matching LZ's digitised Fig. 5 curve (3.4e-5 at S1c>500 phd); Q_W^2 F^2 = 0.9 at q = 246 MeV (coherence gone); the only incoherent lone-NR channel (n knock-out + Fermi recoil of the daughter) gives 1.7e-4 (8e-6-5e-4); every exotic nu-nucleus interaction needs >= 790 low-energy recoils per 200-270 keV event
key_numbers: E_nu,min(248)=123 MeV; frac>200 keV raw 2.5-7.8e-4; N(>200)=4.3e-5-1.2e-4 (Helm), N(225-271)=1.1-3.2e-5 (Helm), x15 lower with WimPyDD shell-model FF; F^2(248) nat Xe 1.6e-4 Helm (node 278 keV) / 2.6e-6 WimPyDD (node 246 keV); isotope nodes 262-307 keV; incoh/coh sigma 0.15 (100 MeV), 0.66 (200), 1.3 (300); knock-outs 0.041 n + 0.023 p events; lone-NR 1.7e-4 [8e-6,5e-4]; excitation 3.8e-5/3.0e-5 at log S2c 4.5-4.8; N_lo SM 1631, mag. moment 20100, Z' 1790-5e5, scalar 786, HNL 1280-20100; hep end point 5.79 keV; Fig.5 green sums 0.176/8.2e-4/3.4e-5, blue-total validation 0.01082 vs 0.0106
model_or_mechanism: CEvNS (Helm and WimPyDD weak form factors) with bracketed atmospheric flux shapes normalised to Table I; Llewellyn-Smith NC quasi-elastic with Pauli blocking; Fermi-recoil lone-NR channel; NC excitation; magnetic-moment, vector/scalar mediator and dipole-portal HNL spectra (HNL cross-section derived)
stance: neutral (constraint: excludes standard and exotic atmospheric-neutrino origins at >99.9%)
confidence: high (coherent tail, exotic N_lo) / medium (incoherent lone-NR)
